name: Avenged Tenfold

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Elaadrin channel crackling arcane power when provoked. The High Order's devotion to logic rests alongside formidable magical force.

faq.answer: Elaadrin represents the High Order and first sought peace with the Al'Aketh cult. After they murdered his envoy and close friend Belathaan Brightwish, he abandoned diplomacy and ordered the cultists destroyed.

Belathaan Brightwish was Elaadrin's close friend and envoy to the Shrine of Akir, sent to open peaceful dialogue with the Al'Aketh cult. The cult murdered him and returned a box to Elaadrin containing his severed tongue, painted with silver pigment.

The Al'Aketh are a violent cult active north of Valanaar, around the Gustberry Fields and Shrine of Akir. They carry prayer charms called Al'Aketh Windstone Charms and reject peaceful overtures from outsiders with violence.
The High Order prizes pragmatism, intellect, and logic. Its members generally favor avoiding conflict and preserving life, but can answer a grave offense with fierce magical retribution.

The Windshapers and Peacekeepers are factions that first answered the Al'Aketh cult's violence with forceful displays and posturing. Elaadrin called their response reckless, but later conceded they were right to dismiss diplomatic appeals.
The Al'Aketh cultists gather north of Valanaar, in the Gustberry Fields and around the Shrine of Akir. Belathaan Brightwish was sent to the Shrine before his death.
faq.q: Where are the Al'Aketh cultists found?

sections.body: The Al'Aketh cult's violence brought armed posturing from factions like the Peacekeepers and Windshapers. Elaadrin spoke for the High Order and saw such displays as a foolish escalation. His order prizes pragmatism and avoids conflict, so he still believed reasoned dialogue could work. He sent his close friend, Belathaan Brightwish, to the Shrine of Akir to negotiate peace.
sections.title: The Diplomatic Overture

sections.body: The Al'Aketh cult answered with a package bearing Belathaan's severed tongue, coated in silver pigment. Elaadrin was horrified and burdened by guilt. He saw that taking the high road had cost his dear friend's life, and admitted the Windshapers were right to reject negotiations. He abandoned diplomacy and called on travelers to hunt the cultists across the Gustberry Fields and the Shrine of Akir, collecting their Al'Aketh Windstone Charms.
sections.title: A Ghoulish Rejection

sections.body: The High Order puts logic before sentiment and holds that avoiding bloodshed is usually the prudent path. Yet Elaadrin shows how cold logic cuts both ways when foes mistake restraint for helplessness. Crackling arcane energy gathers around him. The High Order favors peace, but those who butcher its emissaries face overwhelming retribution.
sections.title: Prudence and Arcane Wrath

summary: Elaadrin turns from diplomacy to retribution after the Al'Aketh cult answers his appeal with violence. The High Order scholar had sent his dear friend Belathaan Brightwish to seek peace at the Shrine of Akir, north of Valanaar.
